claims: Federal income taxes for the 2025 tax year are due on Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
Payment for any taxes owed is due by April 15, 2026, regardless of extension requests.
April 15, 2026 is the deadline to file 2025 tax returns.
April 15, 2026 is the deadline to pay taxes owed.
April 15, 2026 is the deadline to file for a 6-month extension.
October 15, 2026 is the final deadline for those who requested an automatic extension.
Quarterly payments for 2026 estimated taxes are due April 15, 2026.
Quarterly payments for 2026 estimated taxes are due June 15, 2026.
Quarterly payments for 2026 estimated taxes are due September 15, 2026.
Quarterly payments for 2026 estimated taxes are due January 15, 2027.
The IRS Free File program began accepting returns on Jan. 9, 2026.
The IRS Free File full season opened on Jan. 26, 2026.
Filing an extension on or before April 15 gives until Oct. 15 to submit paperwork.
Filing an extension does not extend the time to pay any taxes owed.
Select counties in Tennessee affected by storms have an extended deadline of May 22, 2026.
